stem: A brief summer shower wets the soil surface but deeper root-zone moisture remains low. What is the strongest irrigation decision?
choices: Use root-zone moisture and crop response to determine whether irrigation is still needed rather than canceling solely because rain occurred
Cancel all irrigation because any rainfall fully replaces irrigation
Double irrigation after every rain event
Water according to the same fixed daily volume regardless of rainfall
rationale: Effective rainfall is the portion retained and available to the crop; surface wetting alone does not prove the root zone was recharged.
